provenance.source: Figures supplied directly by the user via a hand-built REIT income simulator prototype (reit-simulator.html, saved as a project doc), ported verbatim into this pack for the REIT Portfolio Builder rebuild.
provenance.note: Price, distribution yield and component-split figures are a point-in-time snapshot circa September 2026 (last two quarterly payouts as of collection: Q4 FY26 and Q1 FY27, plus recent unit prices) — a separate snapshot from, and not reconciled against, reit-instruments.json's own differently-dated figures; see this pack's schema module doc comment (reit-portfolio-snapshot.ts) for why they're kept apart. Component splits reflect each REIT's last disclosed quarter where published; where a Q4 FY26 split specifically wasn't published, the nearest available quarter's split was used instead as a proxy. Which of the five rows below are proxies in that sense is not separately recorded in the source prototype, so every row's split should be treated as a potential proxy unless independently reconciled against each trust's own investor-relations filings or BSE/NSE disclosures. Price CAGR since listing is unverified for every REIT except Embassy — see each row's own priceCagrVerified field. Surface both caveats in the REIT Portfolio Builder's Assumptions panel, not silently.
